selected_gaps.companion_rationale: controlled_diagnostic_design yields the named intermediate object O: matched scene pairs whose instruction, start distribution, terminal relation, and non-geometry simulator state are fixed while a compiler-certified geometry edit changes the feasible relation-event topology or path homotopy; assumption_audit_and_pivot consumes O to test and, if the predicted split appears, overturn the inherited assumption that endpoint success is sufficient evidence of functional-geometry generalization.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This gap is the most load-bearing match to the empirical_reveal commitment because it makes geometry the isolated intervention and strategy-topology change the property to be revealed, rather than treating a new representation or controller as the contribution. controlled_diagnostic_design directly constructs the matched intervention and independent simulator oracle while avoiding regression to generic point/depth injection, fixed primitive scaffolds, motion planning/TAMP, visual replanning, or unmatched domain randomization; the companion audit turns the controlled contrast into the paper's causal claim.
